pitch_routes.genre: All genres except News & Current Affairs and Sport
pitch_routes.route: 4ideas portal for full proposals; initial top-line conversations by email to commissioners. General queries: 4producers@channel4.co.uk
Email top lines to the relevant Commissioning Editor first; when a full proposal is requested, submit via 4ideas (PACT-registered companies with relevant experience).
Email top lines / access or talent queries to a Commissioning Editor (cc assistant); full proposals with decks, scripts or sizzles via 4ideas.

pitch_routes.genre: News & Current Affairs (Dispatches, Untold, foreign, consumer)
pitch_routes.route: News & Current Affairs is excluded from 4ideas; make contact directly with the relevant commissioner using the contacts on the N&CA brief page. Unreported World is produced by ITN and not open to pitches.
Pitch specific ideas via a Commissioning Editor using the 4ideas portal; do not pitch the same idea to more than one Comm Ed.
Contact the Lifestyle-team commissioners listed on the More4 brief; tariffs GBP50k-120k; everything must be repeatable on C4.

briefs.title: All Current Briefs (index)
briefs.summary: Rolling, ongoing pitches by genre; lists 11 genre brief pages. No dated cross-genre callouts were listed on 7 Nov 2026.

briefs.title: Documentaries & Factual Entertainment brief
briefs.summary: Premium access docs, splashy single films, returnable precinct brands, formal innovation, ~1 factual drama a year, First Cut (2026 closed), daring social experiments, talent-led vehicles.

briefs.title: Specialist Factual brief
briefs.summary: Revelatory singles with scoops, popular returners (history, science, adventure, travel, arts), provocative events/factual theatre; climate and AI priority in science; Secret History strand.

briefs.title: News & Current Affairs brief
briefs.summary: Dispatches (plus in-house Investigations Unit), Untold youth strand (16-34, digital-first), foreign films, populist consumer programmes.

briefs.title: Lifestyle brief
briefs.summary: Lifestyle/daytime/features; property bucket full (not seeking property ideas except daytime brief); pitch via one Comm Ed on 4ideas.

briefs.title: More4 brief
briefs.summary: Soft-doc 'intelligent comfort viewing' series; tentpoles, national-treasure-led, low-cost repeatable series; GBP50k-120k tariffs.

briefs.title: Unscripted Proof of Concept Fund
briefs.summary: Development fund for big, original returnable unscripted formats ('poster test'); pitch via Docs & Fact Ent, Lifestyle, Reality & Ent or Specialist Factual through 4ideas, flagging the fund. No deadline stated.
